notes: Every test result uses the same final chronological sample with recorded resolution timestamps.

The v3 candidate was selected from validation and rolling windows before its test metrics were computed; pre-existing candidate artifacts had already reported this same holdout, so it is not a newly untouched blind test.
Group and global baselines are fitted on train+validation after model selection; no test labels are used for fitting.

Negative R2 means the candidate's squared error exceeds the test-mean predictor; its lower MAE can coexist because test durations have a heavy right tail and the mean predictor minimizes squared error.
final_test_status: Previously evaluated holdout; v3 selection used validation and rolling windows, but the holdout is not newly blind.
